denominator_integrity.rule: Speed cannot be established if candidate alters wake eligibility, exposure/censoring, treatment order, workload admission, defer/reject/timeout behavior, malformed-record handling, identity-conflict handling, or completed-only inclusion.

selection_bias_control.rule: Use intention-to-treat assigned-workload analysis and report completion, verified closure, defer, reject, timeout, malformed-record rejection, identity-conflict/quarantine, coverage and assignment-to-closure latency under common censoring/failure semantics.
